title: Write 19 · 洗 考 假 文 条 毛 八 七 菜 衣 服 饿 树 慢 茶
focus: 洗 考 假 文 条 毛 八 七 菜 衣 服 饿 树 慢 茶
body:
Clothes, food and the numbers 七 and 八: 衣服, 洗, 菜, 茶, 饿.

## Repeating parts
- **艹 grass/plants**: on top of 菜 and 茶.
- **木 tree**: in 条, 树, 茶, 菜.
- **氵 water**: on the left of 洗. **忄 heart**: on the left of 慢.
- **耂 old**: on top of 考 (like 老).

## Rules that matter here
- **Left-falling before right-falling:** 八 is 丿 then ㇏, and so is the bottom of 茶.
- **Horizontal before the fold:** 七 is 一 first, then 乚.

cards.Notes: 氵 water + 先 xiān (phonetic). 9 strokes. 氵 (丶, 丶, ㇀), then 先 (丿, 一, 丨, 一, 丿, 乚).
耂 old + 丂 (phonetic). 6 strokes. 耂 (一, 丨, 一, long 丿), then 丂 (一, ㇉ fold-hook). Compare 老 (耂 + 匕).

cards.Prompt: 放＿ · fàngjià · to have a holiday
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 叚 jiǎ (phonetic). 11 strokes. 亻 first, then 叚: its left half (with a long 丨), then its right half, ending in 又. Read jiǎ when it means "fake" (假的).
4 strokes: 丶, 一, 丿, ㇏. Lookalike 父 fù has 丿 and 丶 on top instead of 丶 and 一.
夂 over 木. 7 strokes. 夂 (丿, ㇇, ㇏), then 木 (一, 丨, 丿, 丶). Lookalike 杂 zá (九 + 木).
Hair or fur. 4 strokes: the top 丿, 一, 一, then the long 乚 cutting through. Lookalike 手 shǒu: there the 丨 runs straight down.
2 strokes: 丿 then ㇏ (left-falling before right-falling). Lookalike 人 (the strokes touch) and 入 rù.
2 strokes: 一 first, then 乚 cutting through it. Don't confuse it with 匕 bǐ.

cards.Prompt: 点＿ · diǎn cài · to order food
cards.Notes: 艹 plant + 采 cǎi (phonetic). 11 strokes. 艹 (一, 丨, 丨), then 采: 爫 (丿, 丶, 丶, 丿) over 木.
A robe. 6 strokes: 丶, 一, 丿, ㇙, then a short 丿, then ㇏. As a left part it becomes 衤 (裤, 衬).
月 + 卩-like part (㇆, 丨) + 又. 8 strokes. 月 first, then ㇆, the long 丨, then 又 (㇇, ㇏).
饣 food + 我 wǒ (phonetic). 10 strokes. 饣 (丿, 乛, ㇙), then 我 (丿, 一, 亅, ㇀, ㇂, 丿, 丶). The top-right dot of 我 is written last.
木 tree + 对 duì. 9 strokes. 木 (its last stroke becomes a dot), then 又, then 寸 (一, 亅, 丶).
忄 heart + 曼 màn (phonetic). 14 strokes. 忄 (丶, 丶, 丨), then 曼: 日, then 罒, then 又. Lookalike 馒 (饣).

cards.Prompt: 喝＿ · hē chá · to drink tea
cards.Notes: 艹 + 人 + 木-like base. 9 strokes. 艹, then 人 (丿, ㇏), then 一, 亅, 丿, 丶. Lookalike 荼 tú has one more 一.
